decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Lotus Field along with Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings to generate a high amount of mana quickly. This mana is then used to cast powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to gain a significant advantage over the opponent. The deck also includes various card draw and search effects to find the combo pieces efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Impulse and Dark Petition allows for flexibility in the game plan, making it a versatile and potent combo deck in the Pioneer format.

This Aggro Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing Sacrifice synergies with cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Claim the Firstborn to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Utilizing lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant to generate attackers, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful green devotion creatures and spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival. The deck has a toolbox approach with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Cityscape Leveler to handle various situations, and aims to close out the game swiftly with its aggressive playstyle.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies with cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Claim the Firstborn to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. Generating value by sacrificing creatures and using abilities like Witch's Oven is key to overwhelming the opponent and disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and allows for a unique deckbuilding restriction. Aggressively attacking and sacrificing creatures to maintain pressure and advantage is the primary strategy of this Rakdos Sacrifice deck.

This UW Control deck aims to stall and disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck focuses on establishing control of the board through a combination of Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Discontinuity, and Doomskar, while also providing card advantage with Memory Deluge and Finale of Revelation. The inclusion of cards like Strict Proctor and Farewell helps to slow down the opponent's strategy, allowing the control player to dictate the pace of the game and ultimately outvalue their opponent in the long run.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels early in the game. It also includes a variety of spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to surprise the opponent with unexpected plays and overwhelming power, using a combination of creativity and carefully chosen cards to gain the upper hand and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic to play big green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide additional value and support. Storm the Festival helps to dig for more creatures while Oath of Nissa helps with card selection. The aim is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and win the game through sheer size and quantity.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures and burn spells. Utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Kumano Faces Kakkazan alongside burn spells like Play with Fire and Lightning Strike, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. Chained to the Rocks provides removal for opposing threats, while Showdown of the Skalds helps refill the hand and provide additional threats. Overall, the deck looks to apply steady pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Tamiyo, Collector of Tales, as well as versatile spells like Discontinuity and Doomskar. The key strategy revolves around utilizing lands like Lotus Field and Thespian's Stage to generate mana advantage and card advantage through effects like Memory Deluge. The deck also includes finishers like Dream Trawler and Shark Typhoon to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green devotion creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, to power out powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also utilizes cards like Storm the Festival to quickly refill the board with threats. The inclusion of cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Wolfwillow Haven helps to further accelerate mana production and ensure consistent plays. Additionally, Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection for the deck's key threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive play through utilizing cards that can quickly disrupt the opponent's hand while also dealing with threats on the board. By applying early pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells, it aims to control the tempo of the game and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value and card advantage to maintain its aggressive strategy. With a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells, it aims to close out the game before the opponent can mount a significant defense.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and constantly recurring creatures like Cauldron Familiar to deal damage to the opponent, with Mayhem Devil and Blightstep Pathway acting as key pieces to the strategy. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board while consistently building advantage through sacrifice synergies. The aggressive nature of the deck is further emphasized by cards like Claim the Firstborn and Bloodtithe Harvester, allowing for quick and efficient removal of enemy threats while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and synergies to deal damage to the opponent while maintaining board presence. It includes cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar to create repeatable damage, along with cards like Claim the Firstborn to steal enemy creatures for sacrifice. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and a disruptive card like Thoughtseize to control the opponent's board. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells, with options for both black and red mana sources. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure and outvalue the opponent through sacrifice interactions.

This Bant Control deck focuses on using cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Discontinuity to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to generate card advantage with Memory Deluge and protect itself with Strict Proctor. The deck also utilizes lands like Lotus Field and Joint Exploration to ramp and fix mana for powerful spells like Chandra, Awakened Inferno and Sunfall. It has a mix of control elements, ramp, and win conditions to adapt to different matchups and maintain control of the game throughout.

The main strategy of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures like Soul-Scar Mage, Bonecrusher Giant, Monastery Swiftspear, and Pia Nalaar, supported by powerful combat tricks like Reckless Impulse and Play with Fire. Showdown of the Skalds helps to fill up the board and provide extra damage, while Kumano Faces Kakkazan offers removal options. Chained to the Rocks provides targeted removal, and Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion option that can provide additional mana and flexibility. The deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence and win the game before the opponent can stabilize.
